entities.name: Kawit
entities.description: Amonkheti warrior who became Oketra's Avenger and tried to kill the God-Pharaoh; later re-killed by Samut as part of the Dreadhorde.

entities.name: Oketra
entities.description: God of Amonkhet whose death enraged Kawit.

entities.name: God-Pharaoh
entities.description: Ruler of Amonkhet revealed to be a dragon, who dismissed Kawit with indifference.

entities.name: Dreadhorde
entities.description: Undead army on Ravnica that Kawit joined.

entities.name: Final Hours
entities.description: Period during which Kawit tried to kill the God-Pharaoh.

events.summary: Overwhelmed with rage at Oketra's death, Kawit takes up one of the god's arrows.
events.quote: Kawit was overwhelmed with rage after her god

events.summary: Kawit kills a minotaur Eternal with the arrow and becomes Oketra's Avenger.
events.quote: Kawit killed it with the arrow, which disintegrated the creature in a flash of white light

events.summary: Kawit challenges the God-Pharaoh and he effortlessly stops her thrown spear.
events.quote: She threw the spear at the dragon, but he effortlessly stopped it mid-air

events.summary: Kawit, utterly defeated, is closed in on by the Eternals.
events.quote: Kawit, utterly defeated by the dragon's disregard, lacked the strength even to scream

events.summary: Kawit becomes part of the Dreadhorde on Ravnica and is re-killed by Samut.
events.quote: She became part of the Dreadhorde on Ravnica and was re-killed by Samut

relations.note: Re-killed her as a Dreadhorde member.
relations.quote: She became part of the Dreadhorde on Ravnica and was re-killed by Samut
She tried to kill God-Pharaoh during the Final Hours
